title: Четыре машины — никому не уступить
adaptation: Equal junction without signs or signals, four cars straight on: red sedan (south), blue SUV (east), yellow hatch (north), white wagon (west). Every car has someone on its right, so 13.11 gives no order. Red waives, blue crosses; then by the right-hand rule red, white (2.8 s after red) and yellow (5.0 s after red). No order chips: the first move comes from agreement, not from the rules.
